verdict: Purchases up 57% this week; ad efficiency holds while GBP is being investigated.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.74 for every $1.00 spent on $1,481.68 in total ad spend, and purchase volume jumped 57% week over week — the clearest sign of momentum this period. Ad spend dipped 7% this week, yet return on ad spend held virtually flat (+0.13%), meaning the campaigns are buying more efficiently, not just more. On the local side, Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply over the last several days, and we are actively investigating to make sure local visibility is not leaking demand out of the broader funnel. Several setup milestones — including UTM tracking and the subscription funnel test — are being pushed to completion this month ahead of the September 30 deadline, which will sharpen attribution reporting going forward.
